route: Supabase public training tables and server-only training helpers

flows.name: Enforce learner, reviewer, and automation boundaries
steps: Read published and review fixtures as an ordinary authenticated user
Publish and archive the review fixture as an active app admin
Create a free review candidate through the service-role RPC
Attempt direct service insert, published retag, update, and delete
flows.expectedOutcome: Learners see only published resources, active app admins review and publish, and automation can create only new free review candidates through the atomic RPC.

flows.name: Read typed filtered resources
steps: Apply role, track, type, level, status, and full-text filters
Map topics and role tags into the stable frontend domain
Resolve an exact unambiguous job title to a role
Surface query failures with operation and filter context
flows.expectedOutcome: Server-only helpers return typed filtered resources, fail loudly, and never expose a privileged client.

claims.description: The applied schema enforces learner visibility, app-admin writes, and RPC-only service candidate creation.
Typed server helpers implement every required filter and unambiguous role resolution with named errors.
An independent reviewer approves the permission boundary after remediation.
